scope: Training-readiness research only. This delta does not reopen provider/model/training/physical-GRID10 admission and does not mint accepted dataset tokens.

observed_source_delta.atoms_index_claim: The handoff states atoms_index.json maps atom to row, token ID and measured diagonal response.

dtype_source_tension.observation: The same handoff page says artifact precision is normatively float64 and later describes atoms_basis.npy as shape (46,1024), float32.
dtype_source_tension.resolution_rule: Do not reconcile by inference. Actual bound MANIFEST plus actual NPY dtype/hash/shape outrank prose; any cast or dtype change requires remeasurement under the current codec/ABI law.

external_method_evidence.source: Wei et al., Symbol tuning improves in-context learning in language models, EMNLP 2023
external_method_evidence.relevance: Finetuning with arbitrary symbols improves reliance on in-context input-label mappings and flipped-label following; supports explicitly testing whether Xeno follows the active episode codebook rather than pretrained label semantics.

external_method_evidence.source: Fei et al., Mitigating Label Biases for In-context Learning, ACL 2023
external_method_evidence.relevance: Documents multiple forms of label bias in in-context classification; motivates treating label-token prior as an explicit nuisance factor rather than assuming corpus counterbalancing removes all model priors.

external_method_evidence.source: Kossen, Gal, Rainforth, In-Context Learning Learns Label Relationships but Is Not Conventional Learning, ICLR 2024
external_method_evidence.relevance: Reports that ICL can learn novel label relationships but may struggle to fully override prediction preferences acquired from pretraining.

external_method_evidence.source: Tao, Chen, Liu, Inference and Verbalization Functions During In-Context Learning, Findings EMNLP 2024
external_method_evidence.relevance: Supports separating task inference from label-space verbalization and testing label remappings as a distinct function.

external_method_evidence.source: Hugging Face Tokenizers API and tokenizer pipeline documentation
external_method_evidence.relevance: Token IDs are outputs of a full normalization/pretokenization/model/postprocessing pipeline over rendered text; therefore standalone atom membership is not sufficient evidence for exact rendered token identity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The language-bearing accepted atoms yes/no/true/false/maybe/unknown/if/then/not/and may carry pretrained semantic prediction preferences that survive exact corpus-level class-symbol counterbalancing and make some active codebook remappings systematically easier or harder.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Full S3 remapping plus exact per-atom/per-class balance is sufficient; pretrained token semantics do not materially affect active-codebook binding once the model learns the router.
hypotheses.discriminator: On the same frozen semantic/provenance families and exact renderer, compare per-atom and stratum-conditioned accuracy under ordinary and deliberately flipped mappings. Report neutral alphanumeric atoms versus language-bearing atoms separately, plus each atom's confusion direction. Do not set a promotion threshold before baseline variance is measured.
hypotheses.training_effect: Do not remove the language-bearing atoms from the required 46-atom source specification by inference. Instead make semantic-prior stratum a hidden audit factor and ensure every individual atom is exactly counterbalanced over classes within its admitted split.

hypotheses.hypothesis: An atom verified as a standalone single token can still fail the training ABI if codebook punctuation, whitespace, chat rendering or target formatting changes the tokenization span or token ID at the actual occurrence used for loss/evaluation.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The exact bound target tokenizer produces the same accepted token ID for every admitted occurrence under the frozen renderer, so standalone and contextual identity coincide.
hypotheses.discriminator: Using exact target tokenizer bytes and exact renderer bytes, tokenize every final rendered row and mechanically locate each codebook-symbol span and target span. Require exactly one token for each admitted atom occurrence and exact equality to the token ID in the bound atoms_index.json. Reject any boundary merge/split, alternate token ID, normalization change or target extra token before training eligibility.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Template-local placeholder pools can pass logical split-disjointness while leaving the real 46-atom train/validation/holdout allocation undefined or mutable at materialization time.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A later deterministic substitution step can safely assign disjoint atoms without changing any statistical property relevant to the blueprint.
hypotheses.discriminator: Freeze an immutable atom-split manifest before real rendering, derived from the exact accepted inventory and bound to manifest/tokenizer/renderer identity. Require pairwise-disjoint atom pools, full S3 coverage, exact per-atom/per-class balance inside each split, causal-family/provenance isolation, and no holdout-informed reselection.

must_reject: contextual token ID differs from ABI token ID
individual atom is not class-counterbalanced inside its split
target semantic class leaks outside preregistered allowed codebook representation
audit_outputs: contextual token IDs for codebook and target spans

resolved: Exact source-reported atom NAME set is now available: 46 names with or rejected.
not_resolved: Empirical magnitude of semantic verbalizer priors on the measured target checkpoint
adjudication.effect_on_current_blueprint: The v2.2 logical blueprint remains METHOD_ONLY and non-trainable. Its placeholder substitution gate can now be sharpened from unknown atom names to exact-index/tokenizer/contextual-render verification. No direct materialization credit is granted.

next_exact_action: Obtain the exact bound atoms_index.json plus target tokenizer and renderer identities, then implement TRIGGER2_ABI_CONTEXTUAL_RENDER_GATE/v1 against final rendered bytes. Before any scale-up, run the neutral-vs-language-bearing and flipped-mapping nuisance audit on a frozen family-disjoint pilot.
